units: Hor. 8ᵃ ממונן פ׳ their property is spared (from destruction); Yeb. 9ᵃ. Tanḥ. Kor. 5 שכולן אובדין ואחד פ׳ that all will perish and one will escape; Num. R. s. 18; a. e.—Pl. פְּלֵטִים, פְּלֵטִין, פְּלֵי׳.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 19">Num. R. s. 19</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 765:35">Yalk. ib. 765</cite>, v. <cite ref="Q01823"><he>פָּרִיץ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:8">Cant. R. to VII, 8</cite>.
Snh. 108ᵃ שבחוצה לה פ׳ the property outside of the city is spared; a. e.—Fem. פְּלֵטָה, פְּלֵיטָה; pl. פְּלֵטוֹת, פְּלֵי׳.
<cite ref="Tosefta Ma'asrot 1:6">Tosef. Maasr. I, 6</cite> <he>שיבלים הפ׳ מן וכ׳</he> (Var. <he>הפולטות</he>) ears which escaped the storage.
